content:
most reliable instant swap service for large crypto trades, mine hasn't failed yet, yours?
Before the first bigger swap I searched "simpleswap scam" like anyone would and got a page of old threads. Read enough of them to see a lot were people whose swap sat on hold and who posted while waiting. Not reassuring exactly, but a different thing from money vanishing.  
   
Went ahead anyway, a couple thousand via SimpleSwap the first time because I was too impatient to test, then eight more over four months, a bit over ten grand total, ETH to USDC mostly. Every one landed within a hair of the quote. One got paused for about a day for a source-of-funds check, which was annoying, and they told me it was happening, and it came through.  
   
That's my whole basis for "reliable": nine for nine, one delay, no surprises. They've been around since 2018, which I only bothered to check afterwards.  
   
Anyone got a longer clean run than that on any of these services, or is one hold per ten swaps about what everyone sees?
